title: vLLM-Omni stage ownership and constrained execution search
summary: Trace pipeline contracts, replica affinity and transfer lifetimes before changing placement, parallelism, batching or execution modes.

zh-CN.title: vLLM-Omni 阶段所有权与受约束执行搜索
zh-CN.summary: 调整部署、并行、批处理或执行模式前，先梳理流水线契约、副本亲和性与传输生命周期。

conditions: Choose one concrete model pipeline and record input/output, state, schedule unit, device and termination per stage.
Separate immutable model topology from resolved deployment configuration.

recommendations: Classify each candidate as an existing setting, implementation change or research extension with feasibility and correctness constraints.
Preserve request/segment identity, replica affinity and producer/consumer completion when changing stage placement or buffering.
validation_plan: Check config merge/registry and stage completion/abort behavior before exercising actual connectors and ranks.
Hold workload and model semantics fixed for execution comparisons and validate real output quality before performance claims.
limitations: Lower resolution, fewer diffusion steps, quantization and approximate caches require their own quality budgets.
A schema field or accepted configuration is not proof of runtime support for every model/backend combination.
